title: After two years rehabbing, Tank Dell overwhelmed, anxious and excited to play again

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After two years rehabbing, Tank Dell overwhelmed, anxious and excited to play again
sources.description: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell has not played a game since Dec. 21, 2024, when he tore multiple ligaments and dislocated his kneecap in a game against the Chiefs.
